question.text: The MINIMUM corpus required for a scheme of a Cat III AIF (e.g., Nilgiri Multi-Strategy Fund) is:

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI (AIF) Regulations require every scheme of an AIF to have a minimum corpus of INR 20 crore, and First Close cannot be declared until the scheme has secured at least that corpus. This floor applies across Cat I, II and III. The Trap: INR 5 cr and INR 10 cr are common distractor numbers from sponsor commitment rules (INR 10 cr Cat III sponsor floor), not scheme corpus. INR 50 cr is fabricated. Note: Pages 105 and 397 of the workbook reaffirm the INR 20 crore floor and link it to the First Close requirement.
